_doc: Kit model ranks read by tools/modelTier.mjs when a project has no .agents/model-ranks.json. Case-insensitive regexes, matched against the model id in rank order small -> mid -> top (so flash-lite is small, not mid;   because 'gemini' contains 'mini'). No match = 'unranked': gated like any fallback; the warning asks the user to rank it and `modelTier.mjs learn` appends the answer here. New flagship names rarely follow a pattern: add each one explicitly.

allowed.top: Everything; the project's top-tier areas still at high effort.
allowed.mid: feature work inside one module, UI, tooling, written specs. No top-tier decisions.
allowed.small: content, docs, verify runs, tickets with a ready spec only.
allowed.unranked: treated as small until ranked (modelTier.mjs learn).
